faq.q: Where does the router ship from, and how long does it take?
faq.a: Routers are configured overseas and shipped from there, usually arriving in 7 to 15 days. Once shipped, you can see the tracking number under My Router.
During your service period, contact support for a free replacement if the damage wasn't caused by misuse.

faq.q: What happens if I use up the 2 TB for the month?
faq.a: Service pauses for the rest of that month and resumes automatically at the next billing cycle. My Router shows the date it resumes.

faq.q: Can I choose the exit region?
faq.a: Yes, when you order. The default is Japan.

faq.q: How many routers can one account buy?
faq.a: Each account is linked to one router; to get a second one, purchase with a different account.

faq.q: How do I renew for the second year?
faq.a: Tap "Renew for a year" under My Router and your expiry date extends automatically. If your service has already been paused, restoring it may take a little time.

faq.q: When does the service period start?
faq.a: One year counted from the day your router ships. The wait between payment and shipping doesn't count against your service period.
